intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Cleveland for 2026, and here is what he found: 26 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 18 (Wild Winter Lights Presented by NOPEC) through January 3, with Tower City for the Holidays (from November 28) and The Nutcracker (from December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Cleveland

  • 26 Christmas events for kids in Cleveland (22 already live plus 4 new)
  • 8 free events, including Tower City for the Holidays, Noon Year's Eve at Tower City Center and the Ohio City Tree Lighting
  • Meet Santa: free photos with Santa at Tower City Center on weekends through December 19, plus Jingle Jam in The Land (December 12)
  • Tree lightings: Ohio City Tree Lighting (December 5) and the WinterLand kickoff on Public Square
  • Trains: the North Pole Adventure on the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad, plus train rides at the WinterLand kickoff in Tower City (November 28)
  • Season: November 18 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Families across Cuyahoga County also use this guide to Christmas activities for kids in Cleveland, which covers Wild Winter Lights at the Cleveland Metroparks Zoo, WinterLand on Public Square and The Nutcracker at Playhouse Square.
